experiences.description:
Established in 1973, Archmill House is a premier $80 million custom manufacturer specializing in high-end millwork and premium store fixtures, recognized for its exceptional craftsmanship and innovative solutions. Through the Rapid Re-Image™ program, Archmill has transformed the restaurant remodeling landscape by streamlining schedules, minimizing downtime, and enhancing ROI, establishing itself as the preferred partner for Quick Serve Restaurant (QSR) reimaging projects.

As the Marketing Manager at Archmill, my key responsibilities included:
• Developed and executed comprehensive marketing strategies to penetrate new market segments, aligning efforts with corporate objectives to elevate brand awareness, drive customer acquisition, and expand market share.
• Monitored and analyzed marketing campaign outcomes, implementing data-driven recommendations to enhance future performance, and substantially increased email open rates from 14% to 45%.
• Spearheaded the development and launch of a construction-focused mobile application for Android and iOS platforms, integrated with Procore API, enhancing internal and client project management and communication.
• Successfully executed two marketing “Lightning Strikes” inspired by the book Play Bigger, significantly elevating market visibility and brand impact.
• Planned and optimized marketing initiatives targeting new market segments across various traditional and digital channels, including social media, email, print, and event marketing.
• Conducted thorough market analysis to identify emerging trends, competitive positioning, and customer preferences within newly defined segments, leveraging insights to refine strategic direction.
• Created an Android-based lead capture kiosk app with an integrated ROI calculator to enhance sales and lead generation efforts.

Van Beek’s, established in 1962, is a $50 million entity, serving as the go-to source for landscape professionals and DIY homeowners in the Toronto GTA.

As the marketing manager my responsibilities include the following:
• Spearheaded the transition from an outsourced marketing agency model to an integrated in-house marketing framework.
• Managed all online e-commerce activities on initially a 92-product WordPress WooCommerce deployment to a 1000+ product Oracle Netsuite ERP SuiteCommerce setup.
• Led the transition of Van Beek’s from a WordPress e-commerce (WooCommerce) website to Oracle NetSuite. I was the lead for all graphics, product coding, copywriting, and SEO strategy. 
• Current website has 1000+ products with an additional 5000 products slated for 2024.
• Conceived and executed revenue-generating campaigns, utilizing print media, Google Adwords (PPC), SEO, social media, in-store and email marketing activities. 
• Increased online and in-store sales by 65%. ($695k to $1.5m fiscal year comparison, 2022 vs 2023).
• Produced a range of marketing content, including blogs, videos, landing pages, and brochures to assist with brand development, talent acquisition and sales/lead conversions.
• Orchestrated diverse sales, marketing, and recruitment strategies tailored to the unique needs of each business unit.
• Formulated and executed an SEO strategy for a 1)00+ product e-commerce website. 
• Managed a monthly marketing budget, ranging from $25,000 to $35,000. (Includes seasonally adjusted ad spend and labour)
• Played a pivotal role in HR processes, assisting in the interviewing, recruitment and/or selection processes.

The PSS Group of Companies consists of 13 companies specializing in pipes, valves, fittings and steam ancillaries. With $200 million in annual sales, the group is recognized as Canada's leading manufacturer/distributor to wholesale, retail and OEM customers. 

The group services the food & beverage, commercial building, institutional, fire, HVAC, irrigation, pulp & paper, chemical, mining, water & waste, oil & gas, and power gen industries.

As the marketing manager my responsibilities include the following:
• Lead the research, development, and go-to-market strategies of both offline and online marketing initiatives to this group of 13 companies.   
• Regularly identify customer needs while developing go-to-marketing ideas and opportunities catering to these needs. 
• Manage, mentor and provide marketing-related guidance and best practices to a team of 3 local web and graphic designers and 9 overseas developers.
• Manage, prioritize and schedule all day-to-day marketing activities of all 13 group companies.
• Developed and implementation of company-wide CRM.
• Created an asset management system allowing for the versioning, tracking and sharing of all digital assets
• Completed the rebranding of 8 of 13 group companies. Rebranding typically consists of a complete overhaul of each organization's online/offline marketing strategies, with a focus on increasing exposure and lead generation. Online go-to-market efforts usually include the updating of an outdated website, content creation, executing a landing page strategy, email, PPC, SEO, webinars and social media. Offline go-to-market efforts typically included the development of brochures, technical documentation, giveaways, sales and training literature.
• Provide ongoing staff training; I created guides dissecting complex marketing strategies like a landing page, website, PPC, SEO and email best practices.     
• Introduced my network of suppliers, service providers, and developers; reduced development costs by 80%.

experiences.position: Discover how my FollowRocket service helped Scott Ashley from Smart Cabinets engage and grow his Twitter followers leading to substantial growth, activation and follower engagement.
experiences.description:
FollowRocket was a social media account management service I created dedicated to helping businesses discover new leads and opportunities through the Linkedin, Twitter and Facebook platforms. FollowRocket was a software as a service (SAAS) I created that allowed individuals and organizations to gain followers, build leads while maximizing their social media ROI.  

As the founder of FollowRocket, my responsibilities include the following:

•  Bootstrapped and scaled FollowRocket from a standing start to a three-person service with paid users from over 50+ countries. 

•  Worked alongside overseas developers to create a series of social media account growth tools for Linkedin, Twitter and Facebook.

•  Created an entire SAAS backend and platform that was directly tied to an e-commerce platform 

•  Created a series of social media account tools that allowed users to create campaigns based on:

1)  Keywords and Phrases
2)  Follow and unfollow
3)  Manage and post to multiple accounts
4)  Bulking posting
5)  Account analytics
6)  Follower GPS locations
7)  Competitor activities
8)  Users activities


#socialmedia #twitter #linkedin #facebook

With almost $20 million in annual sales, Nett Technologies Inc. is an innovative company that specializes in the engineering and manufacturing of emission control solutions for compression and spark-ignited engines for both the OEM and retrofit markets. Nett Technologies manufacturers emission control solutions to the construction, mining, material handling, power gen, utility, trucking and marine industries.

As the marketing manager of Nett Technologies, my responsibilities include the following:

• Rebranded Nett’s marketing materials and strategies, reinforcing its position as “the emission control authority.” All go-to-marketing efforts highlighted Nett’s position as a subject matter expert to the construction, mining, material handling, power generation, utility, trucking and marine industries

• Generated leads, conversions, go-to-market strategies and marketing executables that included:
1) Created Google focused search engine optimized (SEO) websites utilizing “white-hat” best practices
2) Created keyword/phrase focused landing pages (SEO)
3) Subject-focused email campaigns 
4) Backlinking (SEO)
5) Blogs (SEO)
6) Google Adwords (Search, Remarketing PPC)
7) Editorials (Blogs) 
8) Press releases (SEO)

• Created an optimization strategy across two websites, nettinc.com and lasernett.ca. leading to substantial increases in page rankings. Using search engine optimization (SEO) best practices led to significant increases in new web traffic, phone calls, and conversions.

• Developed a training website and certificate program for John Deere consisting of distance learning training materials, manuals, and literature using Moodle.

• Researched and wrote monthly press releases, brochures, SEO-friendly content, technical manuals, and email blasts.

• Brought my network of suppliers and developers. Online development costs were reduced by 80%, marketing-related items were reduced by up to 64%.

• Developed marketing tools to grow sales and build brand awareness.

Founded in 1989, PNH Solutions is a large format print supplier for events, retail environments, exhibits, and trade shows with $10 million in annual sales. Based in Montreal and Toronto, PNH Solutions specializes in dye sublimation printing, vinyl printing and flatbed printing. 

• Analyzed project requirements, managed and coordinated simultaneous projects, from simple to complex, in a demanding, fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

• I created and implemented a docketing and workflow system overhauling existing production and file preparation processes.  My docketing and workflow system allowed staff to track and monitor the status of any project at any given time.

• Supervised, mentored, trained and assisted 15 non-unionized employees across three departments (prepress, printing and finishing) to handle an approximate workload of 850+ projects annually from large accounts like Tim Hortons, Rogers, BMO, Walmart, TD Canada Trust, etc.

• Managed and coordinated the daily/weekly planning and execution of projects/programs and deliverables.

• Recommend optimal project materials to customers identifying opportunities for time and cost savings.

• Attend client/ agency briefings, create work back schedules, provide estimates, purchase project materials.

• Liaise with client procurement teams, creative agency/ account staff, marketing department staff and internal and external clients at all levels of an organization.

• Provide production direction to all involved in the project, Issue print layouts, estimates, binding and finishing approvals.

• Championed the daily production briefings with staff while continually organizing and developing company-wide policy and production solutions.

#printproduction #offsetprinting #wideformatprinting #printing #agency #marketing #productionmanager

experiences.description:
As a volunteer Marketing Manager / Graphic Designer, I was a regular contributor of marketing materials and graphic design services to this not-for-profit organization dedicated to assisting senior citizens in the York Region area.    

My responsibilities included:

•	Assisted in the production of all communication materials, including newsletters, e-newsletters, brochures, annual reports, videos, direct mail appeals, flyers and promotional materials

•	regularly mentored and trained other staff and volunteers on web and graphic design

Founded in 2001, Jolera Inc. is a multinational technology hybrid aggregate service provider (HASP) focused on delivering IT solutions for its customers and channel partners. With over $11 million in annual sales, Jolera is an award-winning IT services provider. 

As the marketing manager, my responsibilities include the following:

• Developed and implemented a company-wide marketing and communications branding guide

• As the "brand ambassador," I created an integrated marketing communication program ensuring all departments complied with company branding guidelines for marketing, communication and visual standards.

• Championed and educated all staff on email-blast compliance, procedures, spamming laws, audience targeting, opt-in subscriber functionality and user-list database building. Additionally, I assisted the sales team with email-based lead-generating campaigns.
 
• Created marketing, communication materials and various portal websites supporting Jolera IT product and service offerings. From concept to final delivery, I was responsible (with the assistance of multiple sales teams and stakeholders) for identifying, positioning, and executing market strategy for various B2B product and service offerings.

• Championed the development, copywriting and execution of a monthly company newsletter called CLICK-IT NEWS which featured the latest in Jolera and I.T. industry news to subscribers, clients and employees.

• Led the communication efforts in marketing Jolera's various product and service offerings. Copy wrote email blasts, manuals, guides, handbooks, technical, procedural and transitional documentation for internal staff and external clients.
